claim_text: 30 of 30 participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial were free from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months (broader severe-VOE definition: hospital/ER observation lasting ≥24 h, or ≥2 visits to a day unit or ER over a 72-h period; IV treatment required).
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; PMID 40146367; 'These papers share a study group'
notes: Endpoint reanalysis: 30/30 (100.0%; 95% CI 88.4–100.0) under the broader severe-VOE event rule, applied to the same patient-level data as the pivotal trial.

claim_text: The broad severe-VOC endpoint in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial counts medical-facility visits of any duration, regardless of the treating provider or cause of the visit.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; Table 1/Table 2 (exa-cel severe-VOC endpoint definition: medical facility visit of any duration; no alternative cause; oral or IV treatment; severe VOCs for exa-cel, SCPCs for crizanlizumab/l-glutamine, VOC for voxelotor).
notes: Reanalysis Table 1: exa-cel severe-VOC definition — 'medical facility visit of any duration (severe VOCs, SCPCs for pain crises, VOC for voxelotor); oral or IV nested; no alternative cause'. Table 2 defines the severe VOC endpoint (exa-cel) as a medical facility visit of any duration, any route ( oral/IV nested ), no alternative cause.

claim_text: Eight of 30 participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial were not free from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months.
evidence_locators: NEJM 390(18):1649–1662; PMID 38661449; efficacy endpoint; data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)
notes: Truth: 29/30 were free (1 participant had adjudicated severe VOCs and did not meet the endpoint) — the claim of 8 is contradicted; the 30/30 finding under the broader definition supports the alternative endpoint rule, not this claim.

claim_text: F-cell durability was followed for more than 12 months after the 12-month endpoint in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; endpoint reanalysis, data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)
notes: No durability follow-up published — pilot gap P-012.

claim_text: The CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial (severe SCD) enrolled 12–35 year old participants with a history of at least 2 severe vaso-occlusive crises per year for 2 years prior to enrollment.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; Methods: 'Inclusion criteria for participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 trial included: (1) 12–35 years of age, (2) confirmed diagnosis of severe SCD, and (3) a history of at least 2 severe VOCs per year in the 2 years prior to study screening.'
notes: From the endpoint reanalysis (Brief Report, Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499).

claim_text: Hydroxyurea sustains elevated F-cell proportions in the Townes humanized mouse model at P14 (≈20% F cells).
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the proportion of F cells in peripheral blood was 100% at P0, declined sharply to 20% at P2... Hydroxyurea given at P2 significantly sustained elevated percentages of F cells in mice at P14' (Exp Hematol 112–113, 2022 Aug–Sep)
notes: Townes humanized knock-in mouse model (human γβAS βS globin genes); F cells without HU virtually undetectable at P14.

claim_text: Without hydroxyurea, F cells in the Townes mouse model are virtually undetectable at P14.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the percentage of F cells declined at P14 for treatment begun at P4... F cells were virtually undetectable at P14' (no HU control context — F cells in this model decline after birth)
notes: From the paper's abstract: without HU the F-cell proportion is not sustained (virtually undetectable at P14).

claim_text: Hydroxyurea augments γ-globin mRNA transcription in the Townes mouse model erythroid tissues.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'A lack of augmentation of γ-globin mRNA in erythroid tissues suggests that the apparent increase in HbF in red cells caused by hydroxyurea was not due to sustained or re-activation of γ-globin transcription, but was instead a function of erythropoiesis suppression.'
notes: The paper reports a lack of augmentation of γ-globin mRNA under HU (and attributes the HbF increase to erythropoiesis suppression) — the claim of augmentation is contradicted.

claim_text: F cells in the Townes mouse model are 100% of peripheral blood at P0.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the proportion of F cells in peripheral blood was 100% at P0'
notes: Pilot gap P-004 is the paired γ-globin RNA observation (no values); C-11 is supported by the abstract.

claim_text: γ-globin RNA augmentation in the Townes mouse model erythroid tissues under hydroxyurea is quantified with numeric values.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract — 'lack of augmentation' stated qualitatively; no quantitative γ-globin values in the pilot record
notes: Pilot gap P-004: the paper reports the lack of augmentation but no quantitative γ-globin values; the claim requires numeric data — insufficient.

claim_text: γ-globin RNA is enriched ~100-fold in F versus A erythroblasts in the F/A erythroblast study (qRT-PCR; F/A ratio).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1B — qRT-PCR of HBG in F vs A (~100-fold; F erythroblasts sort)

claim_text: γ-globin RNA makes up about 30% of total globin transcripts in F cells (ddRT-PCR).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358 — 'the γ-globin accounts for ~30% of total globin transcripts, similar to 14–28% previously noted by quantitative immunofluorescence in adult erythrocyte F cells.'

claim_text: γG-globin protein is concordant with γ-globin RNA in F versus A erythroblasts (fluorescent western blot).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1C — 'Western blot analysis was concordant with the RNA results'

claim_text: RNA-seq of the F/A erythroblast study shows γ-globin as an F-cell-enriched transcript (globin-RNA depleted).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Methods — RNA-seq 'after depletion of ribosomal RNA and globin RNA'; supplemental GSE144052 (pilot gap P-007)
notes: RNA-seq data are globin-depleted (spec seed: 'the RNA-seq protocol depleted globin RNA'); quantitative γ-globin values from RNA-seq are not in the pilot — the claim is not quantitatively supported (gap).

claim_text: F and A erythroblasts in the F/A study were matched by CD71, CD235 and forward scatter at the differentiation stage analyzed.
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Methods — 'gated using a viability marker and then matched for forward scatter, CD71, and CD235'

claim_text: At day 7 of differentiation, F erythroblasts in the F/A study carry ~30% of total globin as γ-globin (ddRT-PCR).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1B/1D (stage-matched F vs A; ddRT-PCR: γ = ~30% of total globin)
